In East Uusimaa, giving eligible breast patients 5 instead of 15 sessions would save about 28 patients 282 round trips and 410 road hours yearly; no municipality lies beyond the 100 km commuting threshold, so nights away are few [S34, S57, S60].

1. Radiation oncology heads at HUS, Kotka and Lahti could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases (equal pain relief, more retreatment) [S31, S30]. Askola (66 km from Helsinki): expected round trips 2.4 instead of 6.2 [S34, S57, S60]. HUS publicly mentions pain relief for spread cancer but no schedule [S36]. First step within 30 days: draft it with palliative care [S32]. Goal 3 indicator: national targets and key effectiveness indicators defined for agreed cancers [S61].

2. The breast team lead could evaluate 5 sessions as default for eligible patients (whole breast or chest wall, no nodal radiotherapy), naming distance as a reason; it is non-inferior to 15 [S9, S15]. Askola: 6 round trips instead of 16; county: 282 machine sessions freed yearly [S34, S57, S60]. First step within 30 days: audit eligible patients' schedules [S15]. Goal 3 indicator: patients receive treatment within target times [S25, S24].

3. The cancer quality lead could publish schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band yearly [S21, S27]. First step within 30 days: request counts by home municipality from the treating units [S26]. Goal 3 indicator: regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services [S26].

Limitations: patients are allocated by population, distances run from municipality centres, and schedule mix is assumed [S57, S59, S60].

8 of South Savo's 11 municipalities lie beyond the 100 km commuting threshold from units in Joensuu, Kuopio, Lappeenranta, Lahti and Jyväskylä; Savonlinna is 141 km from Joensuu [S44, S43, S47, S37, S42, S21, S57, S60].

1. The county's cancer services lead could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases: equal pain relief, more retreatment [S31, S30, S32]. From Savonlinna, expected nights away fall from 6.2 to 2.4 [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. Within 30 days: draft the default for team review; indicator: "national targets and key effectiveness indicators defined for agreed cancers" [S61].

2. The breast leads at the receiving units could evaluate 5 sessions as default for eligible patients (whole breast or chest wall, no nodal radiotherapy), at least as good as 15 [S9, S11, S15, S14]. Distance is a reason to choose it: from Savonlinna, 6 nights away instead of 16 [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. South Savo-wide: about 353 nights away, 491 road hours and 17,850 € Kela cost (lower bound) removed yearly, 440 machine sessions freed [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. Nova says breast radiotherapy is usually 15 sessions, yet also 5 or 15 by plan [S42]. Within 30 days: ask each unit for its default breast schedule; indicator: "patients receive treatment within target times" [S25, S24].

3. The county's data lead could publish yearly schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band; within 30 days, agree bands and the extract; indicator: "regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services" [S21, S26].

Limitation: distances use municipality centre points, patients are allocated by population, and the schedule mix is assumed [S57, S59, S60].
